candidates.change_summary: Change decimals() to return uint8 instead of uint8 declared in interface by altering its signature to return a different literal-typed value via an explicit function body (interfaces can't have bodies in Solidity), so instead replace the interface declaration with a concrete external function in the contract file that returns a different constant value—here replaced with a concrete function returning 8.
Change totalSupply() to return a value offset by +1, altering observable totalSupply.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) { return 1 + 0; }

candidates.change_summary: Replace the increment of mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] to increment using the caller-supplied amount doubled, changing recorded debt and thus subsequent mapSynth_LPBalance behavior.
Replace the increment of mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] to not update it (deleted update), so LP balance is not increased on mint and observable mapSynth_LPBalance differs after mintSynth.
After computing lpUnits, move the update so mapSynth_LPBalance is incremented by lpUnits * 2 (doubling recorded LP contribution), altering subsequent realize/burn computations.

Change onlyPool modifier to check the caller equals DEPLOYER rather than curated pool check, altering which callers can call mintSynth and therefore which msg.sender key is used to update mapSynth_LPBalance.
